description: This file defines a ThunderJS module that manages API requests, plugin registration, event listening, and resource cleanup. It exports a default function for initializing with options and includes internal methods for handling promises, event listeners, and proxy-based method resolution.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures the result is a promise and optionally calls a callback if provided.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener and adds its dispose method to the cleanup queue.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Registers a one-time event listener that disposes itself after invocation.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin by name, wrapping it with a proxy.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes a plugin method or API request based on arguments.
